scope: Source-preparation review only; this record is not an external mathematical review or publication approval.

reviewer_record.expertise: Documentation-contract implementation and source-anchor hygiene; not a claimed mathematical specialty review.
reviewer_record.independence: Not independent of the authored source material.

required_expertise: relevant subfield expertise for each frontier dossier
external_review.independence_requirement: Reviewers must be independent of the contribution they review and must identify the source anchors and techniques they checked.
external_review.gate: No dossier may be described as publication-ready, mathematically validated, resolved, or current until this review occurs.

unresolved_questions: External specialists must confirm every SP4D category distinction and primary locator.
Each frontier dossier needs a fresh domain-expert literature/status check immediately before real sharpening or publication.
No runtime ingestion, public rendering, or ledger validation has been exercised by this source-preparation item.

2026-08-17: the reviewer record previously listed only the source-preparation author, which made the two unfilled external seats invisible. Both are now explicit records with approval_state not_started and a checked field that explicitly records that nothing was checked, so an unstaffed review reads as unstaffed rather than absent.

2026-08-17 (independent audit REJECT of the checker): the face rule bound only the heading, the reference URLs, and the locators, all of which a paraphrase preserves. A face could therefore keep every anchor intact while restating the formulation in the wrong category, dropping the external-review gate, and announcing a resolution. The rendered face is now generated from the dossier and required to equal those bytes, so formulation, each variant distinction, each bounded subgoal with its falsifier, the no-resolution language, the expert gate, and every locator and licence bind at once and cannot drift independently.

2026-08-17: added an assertive resolution-claim scan over the face and over every dossier, including the slate. Only affirmative wording is matched; the declared no_resolution_language is excised before scanning, because that field names the outcome in order to deny it and a scanner that refused it would make honest disclaiming impossible.

2026-08-17: the review record now pins the machinery as well as the material. review-matrix.json, check.mjs, and check.test.mjs carry recorded digests, so a weakened rule or a deleted matrix row can no longer leave the report reading as a complete account of what was checked. review-matrix.json is pinned in this report rather than in itself, since no file can contain its own digest.
